## Styling

[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) is set up via `tailwind.config.js` / `postcss.config.js`, with the `@tailwind` directives in `src/index.css`. Existing components keep their plain CSS classes (see `src/components.css`) — restyle them with Tailwind utility classes any time.

## Styling

[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) is set up via `tailwind.config.js` / `postcss.config.js`, with the `@tailwind` directives in `src/index.css`. Existing components keep their plain CSS classes (see `src/components.css`) — restyle them with Tailwind utility classes any time.
